lines.japanese: それからしばらく居眠りしていたらしい。柔らかな風を肌に受けて目覚めた。
lines.english: I must have dozed for a while after that. A soft breeze against my skin woke me.

lines.japanese: 体を覆うほのかな質量。ああ、渡来さんが毛布をかけてくれたんだ。僕はゆっくりと目を開いた。
lines.english: A faint weight covered my body. Ah—Watarai had laid a blanket over me. Slowly, I opened my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「起こしちゃった？」
lines.english: “Did I wake you?”

lines.japanese: びっくりした。
lines.english: I nearly jumped.

lines.japanese: 「え……どうしたの」
lines.english: “Oh... What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: ちょっ、近いよ、渡来さん近い近い。
lines.english: W-wait, you're close, Watarai. Close, close.

lines.japanese: 目覚めにいきなりこんな綺麗な顔を見せられたら、誰だって眠気が吹きとぶと思う。
lines.english: Anyone would be wide awake in an instant if they woke to a face that beautiful.

lines.japanese: だけど心地よい幸福感に包まれたのも事実だ。
lines.english: Yet I was undeniably wrapped in a comfortable glow of happiness.

lines.japanese: 「うん、渡来さん綺麗だなって思って」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I was just thinking how beautiful you are.”

lines.japanese: 僕は思ったままの感想を述べた。
lines.english: I said exactly what I was thinking.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君は綺麗だって言ってばっかりじゃん」
lines.english: “You're always telling me I'm beautiful, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。だって本当に綺麗なんだ。おれの彼女は、内面の美しさがこんなにも表に出てる」
lines.english: “That's true. Because you really are. My girlfriend's inner beauty comes through so clearly on the outside.”

lines.japanese: 「多分ね、付きあってるから贔屓目に見てるんだよ」
lines.english: “Maybe you're seeing me through rose-colored glasses because we're together now.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないって。でも、言われるのが嫌ならおれは我慢するよ」
lines.english: “That's not true. But if you don't like hearing it, I'll stop.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、まあ嬉しいかなあ」
lines.english: “No... I suppose it does make me happy.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、私も同じこと考えてたから」
lines.english: “Besides, I was thinking the same thing.”

lines.japanese: 「って……いうと？」
lines.english: “You mean...?”
“This.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの手がすっと伸びて、僕の鼻先をくにっと突付いた。それだけの動作がひどく様になっていて、綺麗なひとはそれだけでずるい生き物なんだと思わされた。
lines.english: Watarai's hand darted out and gave the tip of my nose a soft squish. Even that tiny gesture suited her so perfectly that I decided beautiful people were an unfair species by nature.

lines.japanese: 「ずっと見てたんだ」
lines.english: “I've been watching you this whole time.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なにを？」
lines.english: “Watching what?”

lines.japanese: 「だから」
lines.english: “I mean...”

lines.japanese: くにくに。
lines.english: Squish, squish.

lines.japanese: 「お、おれ？」
lines.english: “M-me?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきも言ったじゃん。好きなひとだから贔屓目に見えちゃうのかも。うん、そうだ。一年の頃は別にかっこいいとはミジンコも思わなかったもん」
lines.english: “I just told you. Maybe loving you makes me see you through rose-colored glasses. Yes, that must be it. Back in first year, I didn’t think you were handsome. Not even a microscopic smidgen.”

lines.japanese: 誉められてるのか微妙だった。だけど──
lines.english: I wasn't sure if that was a compliment. But—

lines.japanese: 「好きだなあ、羽田君の顔」
lines.english: “I really do love your face, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: ──好きだと言ってくれた。
lines.english: —she told me she loved it.

lines.japanese: くに、くに、くに。渡来さんは手持ち無沙汰なのか、飽きもせず僕の鼻で遊んでいる。
lines.english: Squish. Squish. Squish. Perhaps she just needed something to do with her hands; Watarai kept playing with my nose without ever tiring of it.

lines.japanese: 「やめてよ、鼻低くなっちゃうから」
lines.english: “Stop that. You'll make my nose flat.”

lines.japanese: 「え、そうなの？」
lines.english: “Oh, really?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、適当だけど……そんな気しない？」
lines.english: Who knows? I'm just guessing... but don't you get that feeling?

lines.japanese: 「んー、どうかなあ……」
lines.english: “Hmm. I wonder...”

lines.japanese: 「どっちにしても私には関係ないしね」
lines.english: “Either way, it has nothing to do with me.”

lines.japanese: 「あのね」
lines.english: “Now listen.”

lines.japanese: 僕は渡来さんの真似をして、彼女の鼻に指を当てた。
lines.english: Imitating Watarai, I put a finger against her nose.

lines.japanese: 「はっ。なにするの」
lines.english: “Hey! What do you think you're doing?”

lines.japanese: くにくに。僕も渡来さんの鼻で遊んでみた。たしかに面白かった。
lines.english: Squish, squish. I played with Watarai's nose too. It really was fun.

lines.japanese: 「こら、やめんか。こんな面白い顔を好きなひとに見せられないでしょ」
lines.english: Now, cease this. I can't let the boy I love see me making such a funny face.

lines.japanese: 「それはお互い様だろー。渡来さんの言ってること、いつも一方的だよ」
lines.english: That goes both ways, doesn't it? You're always so one-sided, Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「そんなことは分かっている。私は自分だけ楽しんだ上でキミのことをおちょくりたいと言ってるんだ」
lines.english: “I am perfectly aware of that. I am saying that I want all the fun for myself while I toy with you.”

lines.japanese: くにくにくにくにくにくにくにくに。
lines.english: Squish-squish-squish-squish-squish-squish-squish-squish.

lines.japanese: 「な、なんてことするのーっ！？　羽田君におかされた……」
lines.english: “H-how could you?! I've been violated by Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「先に始めたのはそっちだろー、もう」
lines.english: “You started it! Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、それもそうだね」
lines.english: “Oh. That's true too.”

lines.japanese: ぜんぜん怒ってはいなかったらしい。僕はあっさり無罪放免になった。
lines.english: Apparently she had not been angry in the slightest. I was summarily acquitted.

lines.japanese: 「楽しいなあ……」
lines.english: “This is so much fun...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「どのくらいぶりかな。まったく気を使わずに自分を出して、こんな楽に話ができるのって」
lines.english: “I wonder how long it's been since I could let my real self show, without watching myself at all, and talk this easily.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ……そうなの？」
lines.english: “Really...? Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 意外だった。だって渡来さんは、人間嫌いと言いつつも日ごろ──
lines.english: That surprised me. Watarai said she hated people, but normally—

lines.japanese: 「──クラスのみんなとも楽しそうに話せてるし、かっこよく立ちまわってるし、上手いことやってるのに」
lines.english: “—you always look like you're having fun talking with everyone in class. You carry yourself so well, and make everything work.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は礼を述べた。ということはやはり、認められたい努力や研鑽が根底にあるんだろう。
lines.english: She thanked me. So beneath it all, there must have been effort and discipline she wanted somebody to recognize.

lines.japanese: 「でも、前にも言ったと思うけど、私って人間嫌いなんだよね。もちろんみんなといて楽しいとは思うし、誰とも話したくないってわけじゃないけど……」
lines.english: “But I think I've told you before: I don't like people. Of course I have fun when I'm with everyone, and it isn't that I never want to talk to anyone...”

lines.japanese: 「けど？」
lines.english: “But?”

lines.japanese: 「だけどこんな風に、たった一人の好きなひとといるときが──」
lines.english: “But being like this—alone with the one person I love—”

lines.japanese: 彼女の指が僕の指に絡む。
lines.english: Her fingers entwined with mine.

lines.japanese: 「──いちばん楽しい」
lines.english: “—is the most fun of all.”

lines.japanese: 子供みたいに安心しきった微笑みだった。
lines.english: It was the utterly trusting smile of a child.

lines.japanese: 「なんかね、自分でも驚いてるんだあ。私いま楽しいんだろうなあって自分で思うもん」
lines.english: You know, I'm kind of surprised at myself. I keep thinking, wow, I must really be having fun right now.

lines.japanese: 「驚いてるの？」
lines.english: “That surprises you?”

lines.japanese: 「今まで見たことない自分に会ったっていうか、ああ私にもこんな部分あったんだなって思うよ」
lines.english: “It's like meeting a self I've never seen before. I keep thinking, Ah, so I had a side like this in me too.”

lines.japanese: 「女の子してるっていうか、乙女だな私って思う」
lines.english: “I feel so girly. Like a girl in love.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんは前から女の子らしいよ」
lines.english: “You've always been girlish, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「違くて、どきどきして素直な気持ちでいられるの」
lines.english: No, that's not it. My heart's pounding, and I can just be honest about how I feel.

lines.japanese: 「どきどきしてるの？」
lines.english: “It’s racing?”

lines.japanese: 「してる。すんごくしてる」
lines.english: “It is. Like mad.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはそんなことを恥ずかしげもなく言った。そんなこと言われたら、こっちがどきどきしてしまう。
lines.english: Watarai said it without a trace of embarrassment. Being told that was enough to make my own heart race.

lines.japanese: 「私、いま新しい自分を見つけて、嬉しいんだ」
lines.english: “I'm happy. I've discovered a new self inside me.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、渡来さんはおれの前だと素でいられるんだ」
lines.english: “I see. So you can be yourself when you’re with me.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。羽田君もそうなってくれるといいな。私の影響で、素のままの自分を見せたりしてくれると嬉しい」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I hope you can feel that way with me too. I’d be happy if being with me helped you show me who you really are.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……そうだね」
lines.english: “Yeah... I guess so.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、あの、小さなことかもしれないけど」
lines.english: Well, um... it might be something small, but...

lines.japanese: 「うん？　なに、さっそく変えられそうなところあるの？　いいよ、ワタライズされちゃいなよ」
lines.english: “Hmm? Have you already found something you can change? Go on. Let yourself be Watarized.”

lines.japanese: 「おれ……あの、実は自分のこと『おれ』って言うの好きじゃないんだ」
lines.english: “I... Um, the truth is, I don’t like trying to sound tough when I talk about myself.”

lines.japanese: 「ほっ？」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 「なんか、しっくり来ないっていうか、自分らしく思えないっていうか……そう、だから、渡来さんの前では、これから僕でいいかな」
lines.english: “It never feels right. It doesn’t feel like me... So, when I’m with you, could I just talk the way I used to?”

lines.japanese: 「いい！」
lines.english: “Yes!”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ？」
lines.english: “Wh-what?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんがあんまり嬉しそうな顔をするんで驚いた。
lines.english: Watarai looked so delighted that she startled me.

lines.japanese: 「うん、嬉しい。そういうのどんどん見せてほしい」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. That makes me happy. I want you to show me more and more things like that.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。じゃあこれからは僕、おれって言うのやめるよ」
lines.english: “Thank you. Then I’ll stop putting on that voice.”

lines.japanese: 「言ったらナックルパンチね」
lines.english: “If you slip, you get a knuckle punch.”

lines.japanese: ほんとにしそうだなあ。僕は目を逸らして曖昧にうなずいた。
lines.english: She really might do it. I looked away and sort of nodded.

lines.japanese: そうしたらぐいと顔を戻され、驚いたところに撫でるような頭突きをされた。
lines.english: Then she yanked my face back, and while I was still surprised, she gave me a headbutt soft as a caress.

lines.japanese: ふふふと笑うふたり。
lines.english: The two of us laughed softly together.

lines.japanese: 「このままずっといられたらいいなあ……」
lines.english: “I wish we could stay like this forever...”

lines.japanese: 「うん、僕もそう思う。ずうっといられたらいいだろうね」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. So do I. It would be wonderful if we could stay like this forever and ever.”

lines.japanese: 今まで過ごせなかった時間の分も一緒にいたい。
lines.english: I wanted us to spend enough time together to make up for all the time we never had.

lines.japanese: そうだ、今からでも遅くないんだ。
lines.english: Yes. Even now, it was not too late.

lines.japanese: 「明日は一緒に学校に行こうよ」
lines.english: “Let's go to school together tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　どしたの急に？」
lines.english: “Hm? Where did that come from all of a sudden?”

lines.japanese: 「できれば明後日も、その次の日も」
lines.english: “And the day after tomorrow, if we can. And the day after that.”

lines.japanese: 「三年分、渡来さんとしたかったことをいっぱいしようと思うんだ」
lines.english: “I want us to do all the things I've wanted to do with you for the past three years.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、それはいいね。私もそうしたい」
lines.english: “Yes. I like that. I want it too.”

lines.japanese: 「まずは身近なことだけど、一緒に学校へ行きたいなって思ったんだ」
lines.english: For starters, it's something simple, but I thought I'd like to go to school with you.

lines.japanese: 「……今朝も途中で会ったけど、渡来さん体調悪そうだったもんね」
lines.english: “...We did run into each other on the way this morning, but you looked ill.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ごめん。あれ嘘」
lines.english: “Oh. Sorry. That was a lie.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの言葉にどきりとした。やっぱり避けられてたんだろうか。
lines.english: My heart lurched at her answer. Had she been avoiding me after all?

lines.japanese: 「え、え、なんでそんな嘘つくの」
lines.english: “Wh-why would you tell a lie like that?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……だって、羽田君が私のこと友達とか言うから」
lines.english: “Well... because you called me your friend, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「友達？　何それ。そんなこと言ったっけ。いつ？」
lines.english: “My friend? What are you talking about? Did I say that? When?”

lines.japanese: 「私の部屋へ来た日に言ったよ。友達じゃんかって」
lines.english: “The day you came to my room. You said, 'We're friends, aren't we?'”

lines.japanese: そういえば、確かに言った……かもしれない。
lines.english: Come to think of it, I did say that... maybe.

lines.japanese: でもあのときは、初めてグレタガルドのことが発覚して動揺してたから、渡来さんに嫌われたくなくて必死だったんだ。
lines.english: But that was when she first found out about Gretagard, and I was badly shaken. I had been desperate to keep Watarai from hating me.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　えーと、それで？　なんで友達って言っただけで渡来さん怒るの？」
lines.english: “Wait. Um... then why did you get mad just because I said we were friends?”

lines.japanese: 「怒るっていうか、そのときに気づいちゃったんだ。ああ、友達って言われて、私ショック受けてるんだって」
lines.english: “I wasn’t angry, exactly. That was when I realized it: being called your friend had actually upset me.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。だからあの日から自分の気持ちに気づいて、なんか妙に意識しちゃって――」
lines.english: Yeah. So from that day on, I knew how I felt, and I started getting weirdly self-conscious around you—

lines.japanese: 「――羽田君と正面きって話すのが照れくさくなっちゃった。ごめんね」
lines.english: —and I got too embarrassed to talk to you face-to-face. Sorry.
“Oh... right...”

lines.japanese: つまり、渡来さんは体調不良でも僕を避けてたわけでもなくて、恥ずかしくて話しかけられなかった……ってことなんだ。
lines.english: So Watarai had not been ill, and she had not been avoiding me. She had been too embarrassed to speak to me... That was all.
“Ha... ha ha...”

lines.japanese: 今度はこっちが照れる番だった。
lines.english: Now it was my turn to be embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「でも、いまが幸せだからいっか」
lines.english: “But I'm happy now, so I guess it all worked out.”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、なにか考えてる？」
lines.english: “Oh? Are you thinking about something?”

lines.japanese: 僕も今になって気づいた。あの日、グレタガルドの王女が物語から退場したのは、偶然じゃなかったんだ。
lines.english: I only realized it now. The princess of Gretagard leaving the story that day hadn't been a coincidence.

lines.japanese: 自分の妄想のアスカ姫よりも、この世界にいる本当の渡来さんの方が何倍も好きだってことが分かったから――
lines.english: I had understood that I loved the real Watarai who lived in this world many times more than the Princess Asuka of my delusion—

lines.japanese: ――だから、グレタガルドの彼女が偽物だって気づいたんだ。
lines.english: —and that was why I recognized the girl in Gretagard as the false one.

lines.japanese: 「これからは二人の時間をいっぱい過ごそう。卒業するまではずっと」
lines.english: “Let's spend all the time together we can from now on. Every day until graduation.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、なに、羽田君って独占欲強い方だった？」
lines.english: “Ahaha. What's this? Were you always this possessive, Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 「でも、卒業するまでなんだ？」
lines.english: “But only until graduation?”

lines.japanese: 僕は意を決した。これは彼女と居続けるために必要なことだから。
lines.english: I gathered my resolve. This was necessary if I wanted to stay with her.

lines.japanese: 「卒業したら本格的な治療を受けようと思ってる」
lines.english: “After graduation, I think I'm going to begin treatment in earnest.”

lines.japanese: 「覚悟はしてるんだ。決して簡単なことじゃないだろうし、長い時間が必要かもしれないけど、でも──」
lines.english: “I know what I'm committing myself to. It can't possibly be easy, and it may take a long time. But—”

lines.japanese: 「──もっと長い時間、渡来さんといたいから」
lines.english: “—I want to spend a much longer time with you.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 僕が努めて真剣に答えたせいか、彼女も茶化したり笑ったりせずに正面から受けとめてくれた。
lines.english: Perhaps because I made a point of answering her with complete seriousness, she accepted it just as earnestly, without teasing or laughing.

lines.japanese: 子を撫でる母親みたいな穏やかさで、僕の髪にそっと指をとおす。なんだか誉められてるみたいで力が湧いてくる。
lines.english: With the serenity of a mother stroking her child, she gently ran her fingers through my hair. Somehow it felt like praise, and strength rose inside me.

lines.japanese: 「まだネットで調べてないんだけどね、もし療養所とか援護寮みたいなところがあるなら、入所してしばらく集中的な治療に専念するのもいいかなって思うんだ」
lines.english: “I haven’t looked into it online yet, but if there’s a sanatorium or some kind of supported accommodation, I thought I could stay there for a while and concentrate on treatment.”

lines.japanese: 「もちろん真面目に考えてるんだよ。でもね、あの、どうせならサナトリウム文学の舞台みたいな、空気の美味しい高原で療養できたら最高だよね」
lines.english: “Of course I’m serious. But, well, if I do go, wouldn’t it be wonderful to recuperate up in the highlands, where even the air tastes good? Like the setting of an old sanatorium novel.”

lines.japanese: 「山と海に挟まれた、緑なす丘。よく晴れた日にはテラスへ出て、涼しい風に吹かれるんだ。そして風や紅茶を愉しんでいると、純白のサマードレスをたなびかせてヒロイン登場」
lines.english: “A green hill between mountain and sea. On clear days I'd go out to the terrace and let the cool wind wash over me. And as I savored the breeze and my tea, the heroine would appear, her pure-white summer dress streaming behind her.”

lines.japanese: 「……ふうん、そんなのに憧れてたのかあ」
lines.english: “...I see. So that's the sort of thing you've always dreamed about.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや違うって。だから、昔の小説によくあった話だよ」
lines.english: “No, that's not what I meant. I'm talking about the sort of thing old novels used to have.”

lines.japanese: 「僕はそんな場所でゆっくり心の洗濯をしてから……渡来さんとずっと一緒にいたいなって」
lines.english: “I’d take my time somewhere like that and refresh my spirits... and after that, I’d like to be with you forever.”

lines.japanese: 「ずっとって、どのくらいずっと？」
lines.english: “When you say forever, how forever do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和である限りかな」
lines.english: “As long as there is peace in the world, I suppose.”

lines.japanese: 「あはははははは」
lines.english: “Ahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「笑うなよ……」
lines.english: “Don't laugh...”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ、嬉しいから笑ったの」
lines.english: “That's not why. I laughed because it made me happy.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの手が僕の首に巻きつく。
lines.english: Watarai's arms wound around my neck.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ卒業までは毎日一緒にいよう」
lines.english: “Then let's be together every day until graduation.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、一分一秒でも長く一緒にいたいと思う」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I want to be with you every minute and every second we can manage.”

lines.japanese: 「……もうそこまで言われちゃうと、恥ずかしさを茶化しでごまかそうって気にもならなくなるなあ」
lines.english: ...When you say that much, I guess I don't even feel like joking around to hide how embarrassed I am anymore.

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、そのまま思ったことを言ってくれれば。恥ずかしいことを言っても、どうせ僕しか聞いてないんだし」
lines.english: “That's all right. Just tell me exactly what you feel. No matter how embarrassing it is, I'm the only one here to hear it.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか。じゃあ思い切り甘えるね」
lines.english: “Okay. Then I'm going to cling to you all I want.”

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間、僕の首を支えに渡来さんが飛びこんできた。
lines.english: The next instant, Watarai launched herself at me, using my neck for support.

lines.japanese: ほっぺたを押しあてて何度もじゃれる。少しくすぐったいけれど、彼女の肌の感触がたまらなく心地よかった。
lines.english: She pressed her cheek against mine and nuzzled me again and again. It tickled a little, but the feel of her skin was unbearably pleasant.

lines.japanese: 「は、ははっ……なんか渡来さん、普通の女の子みたい……こっちが恥ずかしくなってくるよ……」
lines.english: “Ha... haha... Somehow you seem like an ordinary girl now, Watarai... You're making me embarrassed too...”

lines.japanese: 「いまの私ならこんなことも言えちゃうぞっ」
lines.english: “I’m even feeling brave enough to say this!”

lines.japanese: 「だいちゅき」
lines.english: “I wuv you.”
